name: GrannyCraft
description: Runs alongside Granny Legacy: Granny's camera drives Minecraft's, her house becomes invisible collision, Granny and Grandpa can be fought with Minecraft weapons, and Minecraft's picture (colour + depth) is composited into Granny's frame. Based on universal-modder's minecraft-gta5-passthrough (MIT).
authors: passthrough core: rehan and universal-modder contributors (MIT)
